    @allure.title("Check login history")
    def test_check_login_history(self, page: Page, create_session):
        login_page = LoginPage(page)
        header = Header(page)
        profile_page = ProfileSettingsPage(page)
        user_api = UserApi()
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            login_page.goto()
            create_session()
    
        with allure.step("Go to login history page"):
            header.click_dropdown_menu()
            header.click_login_history_item()
            assert profile_page.wait_for_login_history_page() is True
            assert profile_page.wait_for_login_history_table() is True
    
        with allure.step("Get API data"):
            login_history = user_api.get_login_history()['items']
            api_countries = filter_by_key(login_history, "country")
            api_cities = filter_by_key(login_history, "city")
            api_dates = filter_by_key(login_history, "createdAt")
            api_devices = filter_by_key(login_history, "userAgent")
            api_ip_address = filter_by_key(login_history, "ip")
    
        with allure.step("Get and verify Location"):
            locations = profile_page.get_login_history_column_text("1")
            api_locations = [f"{city}, {country}" for city, country in zip(api_cities, api_countries)]
            assert locations == api_locations
    
        with allure.step("Get and verify IP address	"):
            ip_address = profile_page.get_login_history_column_text("2")
            assert ip_address == api_ip_address
    
        with allure.step("Get and verify Device"):
            devices = profile_page.get_login_history_column_text("3")
            assert devices == api_devices
    
        with allure.step("Get and verify Date"):
            dates = profile_page.get_login_history_column_text("4")
